response.original_title: The Detransition Diaries: Saving Our Sisters
response.overview: The Detransition Diaries: Saving Our Sisters recounts the stories of three young women who thought that changing their gender would solve their body dysmorphia and mental health struggles. Medical professionals quickly affirmed them, initiating them into medical transition, but they eventually realized it was a mistake and subsequently detransitioned.
response.title: The Detransition Diaries: Saving Our Sisters
